title: AI assistant
intro: Ask about the corps, the calendar or a specific official.
introSub: Copilot reads the same data as every other screen and shows the rows behind each answer, so you can check it.
disclaimer: The copilot answers only from the ARIS data in your scope. It never invents a number.
cannotAnswer: That one is outside what ARIS holds. Copilot can answer on referees, fixtures, coverage, licences, fitness and rankings.

s.licences: Which licences expire in the next 90 days?
s.gaps: Where are the coverage gaps this week?
s.fitness: Which referees failed a fitness test?
s.workload: Who is carrying the most appointments?

a.recoDetail: Highest compatibility in the eligible pool ({rating}), {rest} rest days, {travel} h travel, {risk} friction risk. {n} officials cleared the neutrality check.
a.licHead: {n} licences fall due inside {days} days, or have already expired.
a.licDetail: An expired licence takes the official off the appointment list until it is renewed.
a.gapHead: {total} empty slots across {n} fixtures this week.
a.gapDetail: {done} of this week's {total} fixtures already have a full crew.
a.fitHead: {n} officials failed at least one part of the fitness test.
a.fitDetail: The FIFA protocol has two parts: repeated sprints and the interval test. A failure means a retest is required.
a.formHead: {n} officials are trending down in this scope.
a.obsHead: {late} observer reports are not filed, out of {n} reviewed matches.
a.obsDetail: The observer has 48 hours after kick-off.
a.syncHead: {bad} of {n} calendar feeds are not current.
a.loadIdleHead: {n} officials have no appointment across the three-week window.
a.loadHeavyHead: {n} officials are carrying {max} or more appointments; {name} has the most.
a.loadDetail: Uneven load burns some officials out and quietly loses the others — both are fixed at appointment time.
a.zoneHeadAll: {n} CAF zones have referees in this scope.
a.topHeadAll: {name} leads this scope with an ARPS of {arps}.
